sessionSummary.roundB: Full read-only re-verification pass; found and fixed 3 defects discovered by actually exercising the suite for the first time: invalid .spectral.yaml invalid-ref rule override (crashed Spectral entirely), a stale contradictory test in partner_access_test.go, and archived a stale VC-003 retirement-registry test that asserted the existence of a file contracts-foundation.mjs forbids.
